logger.doc:name: Start Log
logger.message: CorrelationId: #[vars.correlationId] ProductIds:#[vars.productIds] Message: "Start Get Products by ids flow"

db:select.doc:name: Select Products
db:select.db:sql: SELECT p.sku, p.name, p.description, unit_price, p.status, i.quantity_available, i.reserved_quantity FROM products p INNER JOIN iventory i WHERE sku IN :ids

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- payload map ((row, index) -> { productId: row.sku, name: row.name, description: row.description, unitPrice: row.unit_price, currency: row.currency, status: row.status, inventory: { availableQuantity: row.available_quantity, reservedQuantity: row.reserved_quantity } })

raise-error.doc:name: Raise CUSTOM:PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND error
raise-error.description: The requested products are not found in the ERP System

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { code: 404, message: error.errorType.identifier, description: error.description, dateTime: now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss"}, correlationId: vars.correlationId }
